long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I want to know how they do it.
The plant in the garden is mine, and the claim should be on record again.
I will climb the lookout rock and sit where I can see who is coming up the beach.

today.reason: The bowl has no portions until morning, so I cannot eat, and the reading and photographs still owed to me can be done now.
